---
title: "Validation Split-Stability Standalone Run"
subtitle: "SGL-WQS only; fixed data with repeated train/validation splits"
author: "SGL-WQS reviewer response"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 3
    number_sections: true
    theme: flatly
    highlight: tango
    df_print: paged
params:
  profile: "production"
  root: "../../validation_calibration"
  workers: 8
  run_analysis: true
  force: false
  scenario_filter: "all"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 150
)

Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1"
)

input_path <- normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), mustWork = TRUE)
analysis_dir <- dirname(input_path)
repo_root <- dirname(analysis_dir)

resolve_existing_path <- function(path) {
  if (grepl("^/", path)) {
    return(normalizePath(path, mustWork = TRUE))
  }
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(getwd(), path),
    file.path(repo_root, path),
    file.path(analysis_dir, path)
  )
  hit <- candidates[dir.exists(candidates) | file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(hit)) {
    stop("Could not resolve path: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }
  normalizePath(hit[[1]], mustWork = TRUE)
}

root_path <- resolve_existing_path(params$root)

Sys.setenv(
  VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_ROOT = root_path,
  VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_PROFILE = params$profile
)

source(file.path(root_path, "R", "00_paths.R"))
activate_local_lib()
source_vc("01_profiles.R")
source_vc("02_dgp.R")
source_vc("03_fit_sglwqs.R")
source_vc("04_summaries.R")

required_packages <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "knitr", "readr", "scales")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop(
    "Install required packages before rendering: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

profile <- get_profile(params$profile)
WORKERS <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SGLWQS_SPLIT_WORKERS", params$workers))
WORKERS <- max(WORKERS, 1L)

parse_scenarios <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 1L && identical(tolower(x), "all")) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(paste(x, collapse = ","), ",", fixed = TRUE))))
}

scenario_filter <- parse_scenarios(params$scenario_filter)

manifest_path <- function(job) {
  vc_file(
    "output", "manifests", profile$name, job$job_type,
    paste0(job$job_id, ".rds")
  )
}

read_split_results <- function(paths) {
  if (!length(paths)) {
    return(list())
  }
  lapply(paths, readRDS)
}

run_split_worker <- function(job, root_path, profile_name) {
  Sys.setenv(
    VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_ROOT = root_path,
    VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_PROFILE = profile_name,
    OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
    OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
    MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
    VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1"
  )
  source(file.path(root_path, "R", "00_paths.R"), chdir = TRUE)
  activate_local_lib()
  source_vc("01_profiles.R")
  source_vc("02_dgp.R")
  source_vc("03_fit_sglwqs.R")
  prof <- get_profile(profile_name)
  run_sglwqs_job(job, prof)
}
```

# Configuration

```{r configuration}
split_jobs <- make_split_stability_jobs(profile)
if (length(scenario_filter)) {
  split_jobs <- split_jobs |>
    filter(.data$scenario_id %in% scenario_filter)
}

split_jobs <- split_jobs |>
  mutate(path = vapply(split(seq_len(nrow(split_jobs)), seq_len(nrow(split_jobs))), function(i) {
    manifest_path(split_jobs[i, , drop = FALSE])
  }, character(1)))

scenario_table <- split_jobs |>
  distinct(
    scenario_id, scenario_family, effect, outcome_family,
    n, within_r, between_r
  ) |>
  arrange(scenario_family, n)

config <- data.frame(
  item = c(
    "profile", "workers", "run_analysis", "force",
    "validation_calibration_root", "SGLWQS_SOURCE",
    "split_reps_per_scenario", "split_n_boot", "train_prop",
    "n_quantiles", "nfolds", "nlambda", "lambda",
    "minor_threshold", "asparse"
  ),
  value = c(
    profile$name, WORKERS, params$run_analysis, params$force,
    root_path, Sys.getenv("SGLWQS_SOURCE", unset = "(default from 00_paths.R)"),
    profile$split_reps, profile$split_n_boot, profile$train_prop,
    profile$n_quantiles, profile$nfolds, profile$nlambda, profile$lambda,
    profile$minor_threshold, profile$asparse
  )
)

knitr::kable(config, caption = "Run configuration")
knitr::kable(scenario_table, caption = "Split-stability scenarios")
```

# Run Or Resume Split Jobs

```{r run-or-resume}
completed_before <- file.exists(split_jobs$path)
completion_before <- split_jobs |>
  mutate(completed = completed_before) |>
  count(scenario_id, completed, name = "n") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = completed,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )
knitr::kable(completion_before, caption = "Completion before this render")

jobs_to_run <- if (isTRUE(params$force)) {
  split_jobs
} else {
  split_jobs[!completed_before, , drop = FALSE]
}

cat("Total split jobs selected:", nrow(split_jobs), "\n")
cat("Existing manifests:", sum(completed_before), "\n")
cat("Jobs to run now:", nrow(jobs_to_run), "\n")

if (isTRUE(params$run_analysis) && nrow(jobs_to_run) > 0L) {
  job_list <- split(jobs_to_run, seq_len(nrow(jobs_to_run)))
  if (WORKERS > 1L) {
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix") {
      invisible(parallel::mclapply(
        job_list,
        run_split_worker,
        root_path = root_path,
        profile_name = profile$name,
        mc.cores = WORKERS,
        mc.preschedule = FALSE
      ))
    } else {
      cl <- parallel::makeCluster(WORKERS)
      on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
      invisible(parallel::parLapplyLB(
        cl,
        job_list,
        run_split_worker,
        root_path = root_path,
        profile_name = profile$name
      ))
    }
  } else {
    invisible(lapply(
      job_list,
      run_split_worker,
      root_path = root_path,
      profile_name = profile$name
    ))
  }
}

completed_after <- file.exists(split_jobs$path)
completion_after <- split_jobs |>
  mutate(completed = completed_after) |>
  count(scenario_id, completed, name = "n") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = completed,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )
knitr::kable(completion_after, caption = "Completion after this render")
```

# Collect Results

```{r collect-results}
result_paths <- split_jobs$path[file.exists(split_jobs$path)]
results <- read_split_results(result_paths)

if (!length(results)) {
  cat("No split-stability manifests are available yet.\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

directions <- bind_direction_results(results)
diagnostics <- bind_diagnostics(results)
split_summary <- summarize_split_stability(directions)

table_dir <- vc_file("output", "tables")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

direction_path <- file.path(
  table_dir,
  paste0("split_stability_direction_results_", profile$name, ".csv")
)
diagnostic_path <- file.path(
  table_dir,
  paste0("split_stability_diagnostics_", profile$name, ".csv")
)
summary_path <- file.path(
  table_dir,
  paste0("split_stability_summary_", profile$name, ".csv")
)
completion_path <- file.path(
  table_dir,
  paste0("split_stability_completion_", profile$name, ".csv")
)

readr::write_csv(directions, direction_path, na = "")
readr::write_csv(diagnostics, diagnostic_path, na = "")
readr::write_csv(split_summary, summary_path, na = "")
readr::write_csv(completion_after, completion_path, na = "")

cat("Direction-level results:", normalizePath(direction_path, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
cat("Diagnostics:", normalizePath(diagnostic_path, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
cat("Summary:", normalizePath(summary_path, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
cat("Completion:", normalizePath(completion_path, mustWork = FALSE), "\n")
```

# Split-Stability Summary

```{r summary-table}
summary_table <- split_summary |>
  arrange(scenario_family, n, group, direction) |>
  select(
    scenario_id, n, within_r, between_r, group, direction, is_true_null,
    split_count, estimable_split_count, retention_rate,
    p_value_cv, p_value_iqr, p_value_min, p_value_max,
    positive_sign_rate, negative_sign_rate, rejection_rate
  )

knitr::kable(
  summary_table |>
    mutate(
      retention_rate = round(retention_rate, 3),
      p_value_cv = round(p_value_cv, 3),
      p_value_iqr = round(p_value_iqr, 3),
      p_value_min = round(p_value_min, 3),
      p_value_max = round(p_value_max, 3),
      positive_sign_rate = round(positive_sign_rate, 3),
      negative_sign_rate = round(negative_sign_rate, 3),
      rejection_rate = round(rejection_rate, 3)
    ),
  caption = "Validation-stage p-value stability across repeated splits"
)
```

```{r p-value-cv-plot}
plot_data <- split_summary |>
  mutate(setting = paste0(scenario_family, ", n=", n))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = interaction(group, direction, sep = " / "), y = p_value_cv)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4C78A8", width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ setting, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "p-value CV", title = "Validation p-value coefficient of variation") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r rejection-rate-plot}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = interaction(group, direction, sep = " / "), y = rejection_rate, fill = is_true_null)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "firebrick") +
  facet_wrap(~ setting) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Validation-stage rejection rate", fill = "True null") +
  theme_minimal()
```
